alpha_split_convention: The vector Michel call uses alpha=0.025. The pooled-side tv_hat is a point estimate; no finite-sample certificate is claimed for this one-sided result.
check_is_sanity_not_detector_note: The DPI comparison is between the vector law and its pooled-cell image, but both reported quantities are lower-bound/point-estimate outputs; a vector-side Michel lower bound below pooled tv_hat is expected and is not a falsification.
guarantee_scope: The vector-side value is asymptotic, not finite-sample. This artifact does not claim a finite-sample certificate for the vector law.
kprefix_side_object: TV of the k=5/M=1 prefix-symbol law
pooled_side_object: TV of the PHIST pooled cell law, p_service = E[per-flow normalized vector]

protocol.kprefix_channel: PPI[1] direction and PPI[2] size; PPI[0] excluded
protocol.vector_channel: four PHIST 8-bin marginal arrays, concatenated to 32 coordinates

provenance.vector_summary_guarantee: asymptotic HPLB estimate, not an exact finite-sample certificate

vector_side_object: TV of the per-flow normalized 32-vector PHIST law
